question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**reproduces**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses the role of yeast in fermentation, mentioning how it multiplies and produces carbon dioxide.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate the rapid increase in yeast numbers.
